subject: prd/implement-now
statement: A killed, failed, or unauthentic review remains durably pending on its captured revision; an empty-implementation recovery invocation exact-reads only the driver's closed selected frontier, performs at most one attempt per selected member, touches no unselected/exhausted obligation, and performs zero implementation work. The consumer owns durable recovery counts/bounds, issues at most one invocation per round, exits clean only when every selected member authenticates, and keeps exhaustion visibly red.
fit_criterion: multi-obligation selected/unselected/exhausted truth table; kill/restart/forgery/setup-failure fixtures; empty/duplicate/unknown/verified/out-of-scope selection rejection; `drive_round_id` joins; zero-implementation trace; exact-revision retry; consumer-budget/exhaustion evidence; authenticated selected-to-verified transition; three-class counts
